title: Localization functors preserve schemes and algebraic spaces under a change of base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism g : S -> S' of the big fppf site and the induced localization functor j, the functor j_! is computed by a coproduct formula, sends representable sheaves to representable sheaves and presentations U/R of algebraic spaces to presentations j(U)/j(R); dually j^{-1} is described on T-valued points, sends representable sheaves to X'_S = S x_{S'} X' and presentations to U'_S/R'_S (source lines 2949-2979). The proof uses that j_! is left adjoint to restriction, hence right exact, and that it commutes with fibre products and equalizers, so that the etale equivalence relation is transported, for j_! and dually for the exact functor j^{-1}.
